services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: Are you looking for a fresh start and a new career? Do you want to deepen your knowledge of Pilates? Start building your Pilates career path with P10! Our CORE MAT I Teacher Training program is your best option. You will learn to teach the 18 beginner-level mat exercises and be introduced to the Power Pilates teaching tools, philosophy, and teaching formula. Every student new to Power Pilates must start with Core Mat I, as this will be your stepping stone for the Comprehensive Programs. The Power Pilates training program is recognized worldwide so you can take your career anywhere.
